svg.text: Source to production on Amazon EKS with security gates, observability, automated rollback and AI-assisted failure analysis
CI/CD - Jenkins (pipeline as code: Jenkinsfile, configured as code: JCasC)
= quality / security gate (fails the build, nothing deploys)
Docker Hub token, AWS deployer key, API keys,
Sonar token, SMTP - never in Git
Private subnets - managed node group: 3 x t3.medium (IMDSv2, encrypted EBS, no public IPs)
Deployment finsecure-pay (2-6 pods, rolling update maxUnavailable 0)
FastAPI / uvicorn, distroless, UID 65532, read-only root FS, caps dropped
allow :8080 from ALB (VPC CIDR) and monitoring ns; allow DNS
10 alerts: 5xx rate, latency, CPU, memory, readiness, restarts, z-score anomaly
pod readiness, restarts, replicas, node CPU / memory
UIs reached via kubectl port-forward - not exposed publicly
AWS Load Balancer Controller (IRSA) - VPC CNI (network policy agent)
